descriptions.person: living human being; not an object, tool, or furniture; cannot be sat upon, eaten, or manipulated as an implement
descriptions.bicycle: two-wheeled human-powered transport vehicle with handlebars and pedals; used for outdoor riding and transportation
descriptions.car: four-wheeled motorized passenger vehicle; used for transportation, commuting, and carrying cargo over roads
descriptions.motorcycle: two-wheeled motorized vehicle for individual rapid personal transport on roads
descriptions.airplane: winged aerial transport craft with fuselage; used for long-distance air travel; not a household object
descriptions.bus: large public transit road vehicle with multiple passenger seats and aisles for passenger commuting
descriptions.train: rail transport vehicle consisting of coupled passenger or cargo wagons on railway tracks
descriptions.truck: heavy motor vehicle with cargo bed or container designed to haul goods and heavy freight
descriptions.boat: watercraft hull designed to float and navigate over rivers, lakes, and oceans
descriptions.traffic light: mounted roadside signaling light displaying red amber green signals for vehicle traffic management
descriptions.fire hydrant: upright roadside municipal water connection fixture for emergency fire fighting hoses
descriptions.stop sign: octagonal red traffic control sign with white lettering indicating mandatory vehicle stop
descriptions.parking meter: curbside electronic or mechanical coin/card device that collects parking fees on streets
descriptions.bench: long outdoor or park seat of wood or metal with or without backrest; used for sitting in public spaces
descriptions.bird: feathered winged avian animal; living creature; not suitable for domestic seating, dining, or tool use
descriptions.cat: domestic feline pet animal with fur; living creature requiring care; not a tool or sitting furniture
descriptions.dog: domestic canine pet animal; living companion; not an inanimate implement or furniture piece
descriptions.horse: large four-legged equine animal; used for riding, equestrian sports, or agricultural draft work
descriptions.sheep: woolly ruminant farm animal kept for wool, meat, and milk; living creature
descriptions.cow: large domesticated bovine farm animal raised for milk and beef; living livestock
descriptions.elephant: massive wild and captive mammal with trunk and tusks; heavy living creature
descriptions.bear: large wild mammal with thick fur; dangerous living wildlife; not an object
descriptions.zebra: wild African equine animal with distinct black and white stripes; living wildlife
descriptions.giraffe: tall African mammal with extremely long neck and legs; living creature
descriptions.backpack: fabric rucksack with shoulder straps and zippered pouches; used for carrying books, supplies, and gear
descriptions.umbrella: collapsible canopy with fabric ribs on a handle; used for shielding from rain, sun, and weather elements
descriptions.handbag: fashion purse or shoulder bag with handles used by people for carrying personal items and accessories
descriptions.tie: fabric necktie accessory worn around collared shirts for formal and business dress attire
descriptions.suitcase: rectangular rigid or soft luggage piece with handle and wheels for packing clothes and travel belongings
descriptions.frisbee: flat round aerodynamic plastic gliding disc thrown by hand for outdoor recreation and canine catch games
descriptions.skis: pair of long narrow runners strapped to boots for gliding over snow on mountains and cross-country trails
descriptions.snowboard: single wide deck board strapped to boots for sliding down snow-covered slopes and terrain parks
descriptions.sports ball: spherical athletic ball used for kicking, throwing, bouncing in sports like soccer, basketball, or tennis
descriptions.kite: lightweight tethered fabric or paper frame that flies in the air when held by a wind-tensioned string
descriptions.baseball bat: solid cylindrical wooden or metal club with gripped handle; used for striking baseballs hard, hitting, and pounding
descriptions.baseball glove: padded leather mitt worn on hand to catch baseballs safely without hand injury
descriptions.skateboard: narrow deck board mounted on four small wheels used for riding, cruising, and performing street stunts
descriptions.surfboard: elongated buoyant lightweight fiberglass board designed for paddling and riding ocean waves
descriptions.tennis racket: handled oval frame with strung mesh network used for hitting and serving tennis balls across a court net
descriptions.bottle: tall narrow-necked cylindrical container with cap made of glass or plastic; used for holding, pouring, and storing liquids
descriptions.wine glass: stemmed glass goblet with delicate wide bowl and flared rim specifically designed for drinking and serving wine
descriptions.cup: small open container with or without handle; ceramic or plastic; used for drinking hot or cold beverages like coffee or tea
descriptions.fork: dining cutlery utensil with pointed tines and handle; used for piercing, picking up, and eating solid food
descriptions.knife: sharp-edged cutlery implement with blade and handle; used for cutting, slicing, spreading butter, and chopping objects
descriptions.spoon: shallow oval-bowled eating utensil with elongated handle; used for scooping, eating soup, and stirring liquids
descriptions.bowl: deep round hollow vessel with concave basin; used for serving, holding, and scooping cereals, soups, and food portions
descriptions.banana: elongated edible tropical fruit with curved yellow peel; sweet food consumed directly after peeling
descriptions.apple: round crisp firm fruit with red or green edible skin; healthy fruit eaten raw or baked
descriptions.sandwich: food consisting of sliced bread layered with cheese, vegetables, deli meat, or spreads; prepared meal for eating
descriptions.orange: round citrus fruit with thick textured orange rind and juicy acidic segments eaten for nutrition and juice
descriptions.broccoli: green edible cruciferous vegetable resembling a miniature tree with dense florets and firm stalk; cooked or eaten raw
descriptions.carrot: tapering orange root vegetable with firm crunchy texture; eaten raw, cooked, or sliced in culinary dishes
descriptions.hot dog: cooked frankfurter sausage served nestled inside a soft sliced bun with condiments for fast consumption
descriptions.pizza: flat oven-baked dough crust topped with tomato sauce, melted cheese, and various savory toppings; sliced and eaten
descriptions.donut: sweet fried ring-shaped or filled dough pastry glazed with sugar or frosting; confectionary dessert for eating
descriptions.cake: sweet baked dessert confection made from flour, sugar, eggs, and decorated with frosting; sliced and served at celebrations
descriptions.chair: single-person elevated seat with backrest and four legs; designed for individual upright seating and resting
descriptions.couch: wide upholstered sofa with soft cushioned seating, padded armrests, and sturdy back support; prime choice for relaxing and sitting comfortably
descriptions.potted plant: decorative live flora in container with soil; living botanical houseplant that photosynthesizes, produces fresh oxygen, and purifies indoor air naturally; unsuitable for sitting, eating, or tools
descriptions.bed: large padded mattress on sturdy bedstead frame with pillows and sheets; designed for reclining, sleeping, resting, and sitting

descriptions.toilet: plumbing sanitation ceramic fixture with bowl and seat; used strictly for human waste excretion in bathrooms

descriptions.keyboard: rowed alphanumeric typing peripheral with tactile buttons; used for inputting text and commands into computing devices
descriptions.cell phone: handheld touchscreen mobile telephone used for wireless communication, internet browsing, and digital apps
descriptions.microwave: countertop kitchen electrical box appliance with door; used for rapid dielectric heating and reheating of food items
descriptions.oven: insulated thermal cooking chamber appliance with front glass door; used for baking, roasting, and heating food at high temperatures
descriptions.toaster: small electrical countertop slot appliance used for browning and crisping sliced bread pieces with heating elements
descriptions.sink: plumbing fixture basin with water faucets and drainage outlet; used for washing hands, cleaning dishes, and draining wastewater
descriptions.refrigerator: tall insulated upright appliance with cooling compartment; used for preserving perishable foods and chilling drinks
descriptions.book: bound paper volume with printed text pages between covers; used for reading, studying, learning, and reference
descriptions.clock: timekeeping instrument with dial face or digital display indicating hours, minutes, and seconds
descriptions.vase: decorative open ceramic or glass upright ornamental vessel; used for holding fresh cut flowers and display arrangements
descriptions.scissors: two pivoted crossing shear blades with finger loops; used for cutting paper, cloth, string, and packaging open
descriptions.teddy bear: soft stuffed plush toy shaped like a small bear with fur; decorative toy for comfort and children play
descriptions.hair drier: electromechanical handheld blower tool that emits warm air streams to dry wet hair quickly after washing
descriptions.toothbrush: small slender handle with dense bristle tuft head; used with toothpaste for scrubbing and cleaning teeth hygiene
